info.name: TutorPulse Backend API
info.description: Set baseUrl to http://<EC2-1-PUBLIC-IP> (Nginx load balancer) and adminEmail/adminPassword to the values in .env on EC2-2. Run folders 0-9 in order.

item.name: 0 Health & Load Balancer
item.description: Nginx (EC2-1 :80) balances /api and /health across gateway-1 (EC2-1) and gateway-2 (EC2-2). Send 'Health' several times: X-Served-By / X-LB-Upstream alternate.

item.name: 1 Registration Service :3001 - Sign up (public)
item.description: POST /api/auth/register -> registration-service (tp_auth.users). Admin accounts cannot self-register.

item.name: 1.4 POST Register as admin is rejected (400)
2 Login Service :3002 - JWT + login history CRUD
item.description: POST /api/auth/login returns a signed JWT (HS256, 1h). Login records live in tp_login.loginaudits.

item.name: 3 Registration Service :3001 - Profile & admin user CRUD
item.description: Self-service profile (any role) and full user management (admin only).

item.name: 3.8 PUT Admin updates user (name, email, role)
3.10 DELETE Admin deletes user (cascades to other services)
4 Class Service :3003 - Classes, roster, feedback CRUD
item.description: tp_classes.classes and tp_classes.feedbacks. Teachers own classes; students join with a 6-character code.

body.raw:
{
  "studentId": "{{studentId}}",
  "areaToImprove": "Mole calculations",
  "feedbackText": "Good effort. Review n = m / M before Friday.",
  "meetingDate": "2026-10-30",
  "meetingTime": "14:30",
  "meetingTopic": "1-on-1 stoichiometry review"
}

item.name: 5 Content Service :3004 - Practice set CRUD + AI
item.description: tp_content.practicesets. Students never receive answers or clues.

item.name: 5.1 POST Create practice set (AI generates questions from notes)
5.3 GET Read one set (teacher sees answers)
5.4 PUT Update set (title, cheat sheet, questions)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Moles and molar mass",
  "cheat": [
    "n = m / M",
    "M(H2O) = 18 g/mol"
  ],
  "questions": [
    {
      "type": "mcq",
      "q": "What is the molar mass of water (H2O) in g/mol?",
      "options": [
        "18",
        "16",
        "20",
        "10"
      ],
      "answer": "18",
      "concept": "Molar mass",
      "clues": [
        "Molar mass = sum of the atomic masses.",
        "H = 1, O = 16.",
        "Count the H atoms: there are two."
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "num",
      "q": "How many moles are in 36 g of water? (M = 18 g/mol)",
      "answer": "2",
      "concept": "Mole calculations",
      "clues": [
        "Use n = m / M.",
        "m is the mass in grams, M the molar mass.",
        "Divide 36 by 18."
      ]
    }
  ]
}

exec: pm.test('No answers or clues leak', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.not.include('"answer"'); pm.expect(t).to.not.include('clues'); });

item.name: 6 Practice Service :3005 - Attempts, clues, reset
item.description: tp_practice.attempts. Max 3 clues per question (unique index). Every action is streamed to analytics.

item.name: 7 Analytics Service :3006 - Gap Radar + interventions CRUD
item.description: tp_analytics.events (telemetry from practice) and tp_analytics.interventions (teacher action plans).

item.name: 7.7 POST Create intervention for weak concept

body.raw:
{
  "concept": "Mole calculations",
  "setId": "{{setId}}",
  "action": "Re-teach n = m / M with 3 worked examples on Friday",
  "priority": "high",
  "dueDate": "2026-10-31"
}

item.name: 8 Security Tests - JWT & RBAC
item.description: Required screenshots: wrong password, invalid token, one role's token used on another role's route.

item.name: 8.5 Student token on teacher route (create class) -> 403
8.6 Teacher token on admin route (list users) -> 403
8.9 Admin token on teacher route (create class) -> 403
9 Cleanup - DELETE with cascade
item.description: Deleting a class also deletes its feedback (class-service), sets (content), attempts (practice) and events + interventions (analytics).
